name: 4-sa
title: SA — System analysis
subtitle: The system as one black box: the functions it performs, the actors it serves, the modes it can be in and the requirements it meets. No design choices yet.

steps.label: SHOW ONLY THE SA LAYER
steps.text: In the Explorer, ⊞ on SA scopes every diagram to the system-analysis package. The chip above the canvas says what is shown.

steps.label: GENERAL VIEW
steps.text: Definitions and usages as boxes, read left to right. At SA the system is one part, system, with functions allocated to it and requirements it satisfies.

steps.label: READ ONE ELEMENT
steps.text: Select a box: Properties shows what it is. Selection zooms to it. system is the twelve-drone swarm as one black box.

steps.label: TREE VIEW
steps.text: What SA contains, one branch at a time. +N on a box opens what it owns — here SwarmMember, with its two state machines.

steps.label: INTERCONNECTION VIEW
steps.text: The system and its actors, with ports on their edges. Each line is a connection: tasking, supervision, recall, reports.

steps.label: ACTION VIEW
steps.text: The 26 functions of the system and its actors: a set allocated to owners, not a sequence. The 13 lines are flows, labelled with what they carry: a detection report goes to acknowledgement, a receipt comes back.

steps.label: STATE VIEW
steps.text: Each drone has two state machines: where it is in its sortie, and its operating condition. The fleet has mesh modes. Arrows are transitions: trigger / effect.

steps.label: ADD A STATE BACK
steps.text: Before recording we deleted Readmitted from SwarmMemberModes. Now we add it back. A new element goes under the selection, so first open SA › SwarmMember.

steps.label: SELECT WHERE IT GOES
steps.text: Select the state machine SwarmMemberModes in the Explorer.

steps.label: PLACE A STATE
steps.text: Pick State in the palette, then click empty canvas. The new state is created inside SwarmMemberModes; until it has a transition it stands on its own.

steps.label: CONNECT IT
steps.text: Pick Transition, click the source state, then the target: Quarantined → Readmitted. The new transition is selected.

steps.label: GIVE IT A TRIGGER AND AN EFFECT
steps.text: In Properties: the trigger readmissionPassed, the effect rejoinAfterCheck. The line is labelled trigger / effect.

steps.label: AND ONWARD
steps.text: Once checked, a readmitted drone returns to Nominal: Readmitted → Nominal.

steps.label: THE RESULT
steps.text: Readmitted is back between Quarantined and Nominal, as before we deleted it. Edits stay in this browser until you save or export them.

steps.label: REQUIREMENT VIEW
steps.text: Requirements and what satisfies each one. SwarmMember satisfies most of SA's; functions such as admitMember satisfy the rest.

steps.label: CASE VIEW
steps.text: The eleven use cases, from WatchTheTaskedArea to SwarmSelfCoordination, each with the system as its subject.

outro.title: LA — Logical architecture
outro.text: The black box opened into logical components, with the functions allocated to them. The live model: cosmindxu.github.io/mbse-workflow
